title: Vael's Last Letter
summary: Brother Vael has been your spy inside the cult since you spared him. This is his last letter. The handwriting shakes.

goals.say: A loose stone. Behind it: Vael's maps of the Mansion.

quest_book.title: They Know
quest_book.author: Brother Vael
pages:
They know about me. I have hours, not days.

I left everything I learned at a ruined portal near you.
The maps of the Sacred City. The guard rotations. The name of the door that is never locked.

You could have killed me in the fortress. You made me useful instead. I hope I was.

- V.
